messages:
taylor: Seeing a weird regression on console canary: interactive heatmap full paint time doubled. No bundle size change in the canary.

sam: Telemetry shows main-thread parse increased and message: "decompression fallback: lz4 not available" in workers. Looks like the canary landed on nodes missing the lz4 native addon.

anya: The runtime image diff for canary included a small lib bump that removed the prebuilt lz4 binding for linux-musl. Workers are falling back to JS decompression which is slow and blocks.

deploy-bot: canary deployment console-runtime/2026-03-20-tilt by taylor at 2026-03-20T03:12:34Z.

taylor: We should pin the runtime image to include the lz4 binary or relax the fallback to off-main-thread. Quick fix: set worker to prefer streaming decompression (non-blocking) until image is rebuilt.

sam: Also add a canary gating metric that checks for "decompression fallback" log lines and fails the rollout if count > 1% of requests.

anya: Agree. Long term: ensure our build pipeline produces musl and glibc prebuilt native addons for critical libs.

taylor: I'll revert the runtime canary and rebuild the image with lz4. Action: revert canary now.

deploy-bot: rollback started: console-runtime canary -> previous at 2026-03-20T03:45:10Z by taylor. Canary removed.

sam: After rollback, p95 full paint is back to baseline for the canary.

observability-bot: Alert created: console.render.decompress_fallback_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Dashboard: /dashboards/decompress-fallback-6167001234.

anya: File an ops-runbook entry for missing native addons in runtime images. Also add an e2e that runs headless canary and checks for native addon availability.
